sources.title: Saraswathy/vlm-mix-geometry-expert-step100 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: VLM-Mix Geometry Expert (Step 100) A rank-64 grade-school geometry specialist trained for the VLM mixture experiments. This is a PEFT LoRA adapter for Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct, pinned during evaluation to base revision ebb281ec70b05090aa6165b016eac8ec08e71b17. It contains adapter weights only, not the base model or training images.

sources.title: Saraswathy Amjith - saraamjith.com
sources.snippet: A self-questioning framework that trains a VLM to decompose compositional visual questions into sub-questions using GRPO, without any reasoning demonstrations. Applied to a 3B-parameter model on CLEVR and A-OKVQA, both self-questioning and standard RL substantially improve accuracy over the untrained model.
